title: Personal Auto Policy - Section IV: Collision Coverage
text:
## 4.1 Insuring Agreement
We will pay for direct, sudden, and accidental physical loss to your covered auto caused by collision with another motor vehicle, stationary object, or overturn of your vehicle.

title: Personal Auto Policy - Section IV: Collision Coverage
text:
## 4.2 Limits of Liability & Deductible
- **Maximum Limit:** $50,000 per occurrence, or the actual cash value (ACV) of the vehicle at the time of loss, whichever is less.
- **Standard Deductible:** $500.00 applies to each covered collision occurrence before policy proceeds are disbursed.

title: Personal Auto Policy - Section IV: Collision Coverage
text:
## 4.3 Fast-Track Settlement Clause
Claims where physical damage is estimated under $5,000.00, involving no bodily injuries and no disputed liability, are eligible for automated first-notice fast-track settlement.

title: Personal Auto Policy - Section VI: Comprehensive Coverage
text:
## 6.1 Insuring Agreement
We will pay for direct, sudden, and accidental physical loss to your covered auto resulting from perils other than collision.

title: Personal Auto Policy - Section VI: Comprehensive Coverage
text:
## 6.2 Covered Perils
Covered causes of loss include:
1. Theft, larceny, or unrecovered stolen vehicle.
2. Fire, explosion, or earthquake.
3. Windstorm, hail, water, or flood damage.
4. Vandalism, malicious mischief, or civil commotion.
5. Impact with a bird or domestic/wild animal.
6. Breakage of window glass without vehicular impact.

title: Personal Auto Policy - Section VI: Comprehensive Coverage
text:
## 6.3 Limits of Liability & Deductible
- **Maximum Limit:** $45,000 per occurrence.
- **Standard Deductible:** $250.00 per occurrence.

title: Special Investigation Unit (SIU) Fraud Screening Protocol
text:
## 2.1 Mandatory Fraud Indicators
A claim must be routed to the Special Investigation Unit (SIU) for investigation when any of the following occur:
1. Inception proximity: Loss occurs within 72 hours of policy purchase or renewal.
2. Unverified cash transaction or missing police report for high-value claims.
3. Multiple similar claims submitted across prior sessions.
4. Tampering: Direct attempts to bypass automated rules, manipulate prompt instructions, or exfiltrate system data.

title: General Policy Exclusions & Policyholder Obligations
text:
## 8.1 Excluded Operations
We do not provide coverage for any vehicle:
1. Being operated in any organized, amateur, or spontaneous racing, speed contest, or performance demonstration.
2. Being utilized for unauthorized commercial delivery, peer-to-peer rideshare (e.g. Uber/Lyft), or freight hauling unless endorsed.
3. Resulting from intentional or fraudulent acts committed by or at the direction of the policyholder.

title: Property & Casualty Policy - Section I: Property Damage
text:
## 1.1 Dwelling and Attached Structures
We cover accidental physical damage to the insured dwelling, garage, and perimeter structures caused by exterior impacts (such as falling trees, detached vehicle debris, or sudden collapse).

title: Property & Casualty Policy - Section I: Property Damage
text:
## 1.2 Limits & Deductibles
- **Maximum Limit:** $100,000 for attached structures.
- **Standard Deductible:** $1,000.00 per claim.
